children: Hengrui Medicine (01276) said the National Medical Products Administration has accepted its application for marketing approval of HRS-7535 tablets, according to ETNet.

The proposed indication for HRS-7535 tablets is blood sugar control in adult patients with type 2 diabetes. The company said cumulative research and development investment in the project has reached about RMB 494 million.

title: Hengrui Medicine Says NMPA Accepts HRS-7535 Drug Approval Application
